prompt_head:
Role: AI Engineer at OneStream
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 1-3 years of experience building and deploying production-level machine learning

assessments.note: Partial: production systems experience but limited direct ML solution deployment.
Met: strong Python and C++ experience with production code.
Met: extensive relevant work experience compensates incomplete degree.
Met: comparable experience in systems engineering despite non‑CS degree.
Partial: web framework experience, but no Flask/FastAPI.
Partial: cloud and distributed systems knowledge, Azure not demonstrated.
Met: built complex agent pipelines and trading engine.
Met: rapid adoption of varied technologies across projects.
Partial: mentoring indicates interpersonal skills, no explicit evidence of written communication.
Met: uses Git, writes clean code in C++ and Python.
Met: proven ability to prioritize in high‑pressure sales role.
Met: founder and top‑performer shows self‑motivation.
Met: detailed validation pipelines and supply accountability.
Partial: presented to enterprise clients, unclear C‑level exposure.

output.verdict_line: Candidate meets most core requirements but lacks specific Flask/Azure experience and direct ML production work.
top_gaps: 1-3 years building and deploying production-level ML solutions
Experience with Flask and FastAPI web frameworks
